question: What causal distinction is asserted between Brahman and prakṛti?
premises: Brahman is stated to have no cause.
Prakṛti is stated to have a cause.
The teaching is addressed to the beautiful one.
inference: Brahman is uncaused, whereas prakṛti has a cause.
uncertainties: The specific cause of prakṛti is not named in this verse.
plain_english: O beautiful one, Brahman has no cause, but prakṛti does have a cause.
